title: Pledge
headerImageAlt: Church of the Epiphany in Eden, North Carolina
intro:
Dear Friends,

Jesus said, “In my Father’s house there are many dwelling places,” John 14:2, NRSV. This promise of abundance and welcome lies at the heart of our stewardship theme: Plenty Good Room. 

This season we are connecting through the idea “Stewardship is Fellowship” and how we are called to share our resources and nurture our relationships. Now it is time for our response. Stewardship is our faithful reply to God’s generosity. It is gratitude put into action.

Our campaign materials and a pledge / promise card will be available soon. We invite you to prayerfully consider your response and return your pledge by December 6. An online form is below.

Every gift matters. Every commitment sustains our worship, our learning, our fellowship, and our outreach to those in need.

This is not only an appeal for funds - it is an invitation to claim your place in God’s household, to make room for others, and to live into God’s abundance. When we respond together, we become the church God is calling us to be: a community with plenty good room for all.

Thank you for your faithful and generous response to this call.

With gratitude,

Donna Turner 
Campaign Chair
